glosses: to potter; to tamper; to move things back and forth (about the house); to be busy (with minor tasks)

examples.text: Ich weiß nich’, wo die Mama is’. Die is’ hier schon den ganzen Tag überall am Krösen...
examples.translation: I don’t know where Mum is. She’s been pottering about the house all day...
examples.english: I don’t know where Mum is. She’s been pottering about the house all day...

examples.text: Ich hab hier grad ma’ in der Schublade gekröst, un’ kuck ma’, wat ich da gefunden hab!
examples.translation: I was just rummaging in this drawer for a bit, and take a look what I've found!
examples.english: I was just rummaging in this drawer for a bit, and take a look what I've found!
